label: rejected

evidence.V1: Big dome cap on a tall stem with two small kid mushrooms reads clearly as a mushroom tree in front, 3q, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: Clear big cap / medium kid mushrooms / small cream spots hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Cap is a pleasant dome but the main stem is a stiff straight cylinder and the spots are bunched on one side of the cap (top view: large empty dome, spots only at left and rim).
evidence.V4: Base flare and cap rim are softened, but the spots are hard octagon discs and the cap rim/underside shows stepped polygon edges (front view jagged underside, cap_spots close-up).
evidence.V5: Low-segment faceting visible on the spots and on the cap rim band (cap_spots and gills close-ups); the 'gills' close-up shows no underside detail at all.
evidence.V6: One cap hue (red) in two values plus cream stem/spots; colourways teal/ember keep the same discipline.
evidence.V8: White vertex-colour material and smooth shading match, but faceted spot discs and polygonal rim are a minor mismatch with the smooth fused nature style.
evidence.V9: Static scenery: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Faceted octagonal spots with hard polygon outlines (cap_spots close-up)
Stepped/jagged cap rim and underside edge (front view, gills close-up)
top_fixes: Redistribute the spots evenly over the cap (several large on top, smaller toward the rim) and raise their segment count so they are round
Add gills/underside detail and smooth the cap rim silhouette
Give the main stem a slight curve and taper/bulge so it is less of a straight cylinder
